concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-security-two-factor-authentication]] - Control Panel 2FA access requirement, app/SMS and WebAuthn security-key routes, factor fallback, Account Admin-assisted lockout recovery and self-service reset limits, kept distinct from payment authentication and fraud tools
warnings: Keep this route under Control Panel account access; do not conflate it with 3D Secure, transaction fraud screening or payment-method authentication.
Preserve the difference between Account Admin temporary disablement for another user and a user's self-service reset; the page says users cannot disable 2FA for themselves.
Treat the September 2023 requirement and method compatibility as claims in the 2026-09-16 collected snapshot, not independently verified current support.
Do not generalize the page's Control Panel-user scope to API credentials, PayPal-credential login or customer authentication.
